objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that passes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning and archiving lifecycle stages.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the document in the document pyramid (Level 1–4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation used in the document name (e.g. RL for guideline).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client 4-digit number assigned per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force, Archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus the validity period.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configured period for validity extension check (default 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language of the document content.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to related master data, IT applications, other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas of validity associated with the document.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Clients in which the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and can be published directly.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Published or unpublished status of the additional information.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by an author to request a change to an existing released document, managed independently of the document version history.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Details of the proposed change.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request triggered 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend or revise the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the validity extension request.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a released document and archive it, withdrawing it from circulation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the override request.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, restoring it to active lifecycle.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user assigned as the primary creator and responsible editor of a document, with read and write permissions.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: A user assigned additional write permissions on a document who can initiate the release process but does not sign as creator.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user responsible for checking a document's content for technical and formal correctness before release.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user responsible for approving and authorizing the final release of a document to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user who translates released document content into another language.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A defined group of users used to assign read or change authorizations and distribution membership.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Name of the user group (e.g. Reader - Document Management, Archive).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to a document to be notified or required to acknowledge upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance that guides a document through the steps of the release, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement process.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (e.g. Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Acknowledgement, Translation Release).

attributes.name: workflow_status
attributes.description: Current step or status of the workflow instance.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature recorded by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step, documented per released version.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Identity of the person who provided the signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the signature was applied.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step at which the signature was provided (Creator, Review, Release).

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

attributes.name: template_name
attributes.description: Name of the template.

attributes.name: associated_document_type
attributes.description: Document type for which this template is available.

objs.name: report
objs.description: An evaluation or search report available in the system providing filtered results based on selection parameters.

attributes.name: report_name
attributes.description: Name of the report (e.g. Status report: Documents & Instruction, Search for documents & instructions).

attributes.name: role_scope
attributes.description: Role for which the report is available (Reader or Author).

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen during creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The template chosen during creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated via the properties editing dialog.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: The metadata category being edited (e.g. Master data, Control (release)).

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: A saved document is automatically converted to PDF format by the system for web display.

evts.name: initiate_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator - Review - Release) is started by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and/or formal correctness and completes the review task with an electronic signature.

attributes.name: review_outcome
attributes.description: Positive approval or rejection of the review.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document with an electronic signature, making it available to addressed readers.

attributes.name: release_outcome
attributes.description: Positive approval or rejection of the release.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the approval workflow, canceling the workflow for all subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_step
attributes.description: The workflow step at which rejection occurred (Review or Release).

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and becomes visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content changes, attribute changes, attachment changes, or scheduled change proposals.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: Reason for the new version (content change, attribute change, attachment change, change proposal).

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An attachment (controlled sub-document) is created and linked to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is created and attached to a document without affecting the document's version or release cycle.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is released and published directly via property switches.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is directly deleted from a document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, triggering a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the completion of an assigned change proposal, notifying the proposal creator.

evts.name: generate_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before a document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally author and reviewer) confirms the document's continued validity, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document and archive it.

evts.name: approve_override
evts.description: The override request is approved through the workflow, setting the document status to Out of Force and revoking authorizations.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: An invalidated document and its attachments are archived, revoking all rights except for the archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: An archived document is physically deleted from the system after the archive duration has expired.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A member of the Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms the reactivation, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata, authorizations and attachments.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a specific document.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Type of authorization assigned (read, write).

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are assigned to a document's distribution list for e-mail notification or acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution maintained (e-mail or acknowledgement).

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends an e-mail to inform users about workflow tasks, release, validity extension, or other document events.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Type of notification (workflow task, release, validity extension, override, acknowledgement request).

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Upon release, persons and user group members on the acknowledgement distribution list are requested to confirm acknowledgement.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A reader confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator translates the released content of a document into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: Language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated document version is checked and released through a workflow, making it visible in the corresponding login language.
